category_title: Students with high online continuity and regular LMS engagement
minimal_context: The student is writing a post about their weekend plans on the online discussion board and replying to peers.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please post a few lines describing your plans for the weekend on the discussion board, and then respond to two of your peers.

STUDENT: Okay, I posted my sentences: 'I will go to the park this weekend. I will play soccer.'

TUTOR: Can you write a bit more about that?

STUDENT: I don't know many words yet. I will just add: 'I like the park. It is good.'

TUTOR: Please make sure to reply to your classmates' posts now.

STUDENT: I replied to John. I just wrote 'Me too, I have the same plans.' I don't know how to say anything else to start a real discussion.

options.A: Lower expectations for the student and tell them to write one sentence instead of a few lines.
options.B: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time writing the discussion posts.
options.C: Facilitate discourse by setting a supportive climate for learning on the online discussion board.
options.D: Advise the student to take a short 5-15 minute break from the discussion board and return punctually.
